groups.canonical_name: Multijurisdictional tax rate and law changes
groups.definition: Changes in tax rates or rules (such as OECD BEPS) across the many jurisdictions where the company operates could raise its effective tax rate or impair the realizability of deferred tax assets.

groups.canonical_name: Transfer pricing and tax asset challenges
groups.definition: Tax authorities may dispute the company's transfer pricing arrangements or challenge acquisition-related tax assets and loss carryforwards, leading to additional tax liabilities.
